scripts.dev:next: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examples --with data next dev -p {examples} 2>&1 | tee .logs/dev-next.log
scripts.dev:vue: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examplesVue --with data vite 2>&1 | tee .logs/dev-vue.log
scripts.dev:angular: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examplesAngular --with data npm run dev:angular:in-ports 2>&1 | tee .logs/dev-angular.log
scripts.//dev:angular:in-ports: builds the library once (rerun build:angular-lib after a library change: ng serve picks it up), then rewrites the routes when a .page.angular.ts is added or removed
scripts.dev:angular:in-ports: npm run build:angular-lib && node scripts/generate-angular-app.js --dev && concurrently -k --names "routes,ng" "node scripts/generate-angular-app.js --watch" "ng serve --port $INFINITE_PORT_EXAMPLES_ANGULAR"
scripts.dev:test-runner: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for testRunner node scripts/test-runner-server.js 2>&1 | tee .logs/dev-test-runner.log
scripts.build: rimraf .next && NODE_ENV=production node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --with data next build
scripts.build:vue: npm run --prefix ../source esbuild:vue:dev && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --with data vite build
scripts.//build:angular-lib: the dev (__DEV__) build of @infinite-table/infinite-angular, in examples/.angular-lib so that it imports the app's copy of Angular. The touch: index.css only exists once the package has styles, src/angular-app/styles.css imports it
scripts.build:angular-lib: rimraf .angular-lib && npm run --prefix ../source ngc:angular && INFINITE_OUT_FOLDER=../examples/.angular-lib/infinite-angular npm run --prefix ../source esbuild:angular:dev && INFINITE_OUT_FOLDER=../examples/.angular-lib/infinite-angular npm run --prefix ../source generate-dts-file:angular && touch .angular-lib/infinite-angular/index.css
scripts.build:angular: npm run build:angular-lib && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --with data node scripts/generate-angular-app.js && ng build --stats-json && node scripts/check-angular-build.js
scripts.test: node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examples,examplesVue,examplesAngular --with data npm run test:in-ports
scripts.test-local: node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examples,examplesVue,examplesAngular --with data npm run test-local:in-ports
scripts.//test:in-ports: the builds (which inline the data URL) and the servers of one test run share one choice of ports
scripts.test:in-ports: npm run build && npm run build:vue && npm run build:angular && npm run run-test
scripts.test-local:in-ports: npm run build-local && npm run build:vue && npm run build:angular && npm run run-test
scripts.run-test: node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examples,examplesVue,examplesAngular --with data concurrently -s first --kill-others "npm run start-server" "npm run start-server:vue" "npm run start-server:angular" "npm run play:test:split"
scripts.start-server: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examples http-server -p {examples} out -c300000 -s 2>&1 | tee .logs/start-server.log
scripts.start-server:vue: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examplesVue http-server -p {examplesVue} out-vue -c300000 -s --proxy http://localhost:{examplesVue}? 2>&1 | tee .logs/start-server-vue.log
scripts.start-server:angular: mkdir -p .logs && node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examplesAngular http-server -p {examplesAngular} out-angular -c300000 -s --proxy http://localhost:{examplesAngular}? 2>&1 | tee .logs/start-server-angular.log
scripts.play:test:split: npm run play:test:functional && npm run play:test:perf
scripts.test:debug:
chokidar '**/*.spec.ts'  -c 'echo "
{path} was modified
" && npm run play:test -- --retries=0 {path} --debug'
scripts.ci:test: node ../scripts/with-ports.mjs --for examples,examplesVue,examplesAngular --with data concurrently -s first --kill-others "npm run start-server" "npm run start-server:vue" "npm run start-server:angular" "npm run play:test:split"
scripts.benchmark: npm run benchmark:build && npm run benchmark:run
